newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Cattle clashes leave nine dead in northern Nigeria.
newsitem.headline: Cattle clashes leave nine dead in northern Nigeria.

text.p: Nine people were killed when farmers and cattle herders fought with swords and bows and arrows in northern Nigeria last week, local newspapers reported on Monday.
The majority state-owned Daily Times said 22 suspects from the village of Gwadaba are being questioned at the police headquarters in the regional capital Sokoto about the clashes.
Clashes between farmers and herders are not uncommon in the arid north of Nigeria where animals frequently stray onto the sparse agricultural land.
